description: V0.17 curated naming batch 8 (22 entries). ARM9 semantic names from capstone disasm (callers>=4): linked-list insert/remove, IRQ-safe global word store / AND-NOT clear, clz scan, signed halfword fixed-point convert, IO flag pair ops, init sequences.

names.name: globals_reset_and_call_twice
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r0,[pc,#0x34]; ldr r1,[pc,#0x34]; ldr r0,[r0]; mov r2,#0; str r2,[r1]; bl 0x2028840; ldr r0,[pc,#0x24]; ldr r0,[r0]; bl 0x2028840
names.note: callers=5. Zero a global then call 0x2028840 twice with two global ptrs.

names.name: two_global_state_check
names.disasm: ldr r2,[pc,#0x4c]; ldr r2,[r2]; cmp r2,#0; bne...; ldr r2,[pc,#0x40]; ldr r2,[r2]; cmp r2,#0; beq...; ldr r2,[pc,#0x34]; mov r3,#1
names.note: callers=5. Branch on two global flags (both zero / nonzero states).

names.name: global_dword64_store
names.disasm: push {r0,r1,r2,r3}; ldr r2,[sp]; ldr r0,[pc,#0x10]; ldr r1,[sp,#4]; str r2,[r0]; str r1,[r0,#4]; add sp,sp,#0x10; bx lr
names.note: callers=5. Store 64-bit value (two stack words) to global ptr [0]/[4].

names.name: conditional_dual_global_store
names.disasm: cmp r0,#0; ldreq r1,[pc,#0x10]; ldreq r0,[pc,#0x10]; streq r1,[r0]; ldrne r1,[pc,#8]; strne r0,[r1]; bx lr
names.note: callers=5. r0==0 -> store const to global A; else store r0 to global B.

names.name: cond_field_read
names.disasm: cmp r1,#0; ldreq r0,[r0,#4]; ldrhne r0,[r0,#0xa]; ldrne r0,[r1,r0]; bx lr
names.note: callers=5. r1==0 -> word [r0+4]; else indexed halfword [r0+0xa]+r1.

names.name: node_init_with_size
names.disasm: ldr r3,[r0]; mov r2,#0; strh r1,[r3]; strh r2,[r3,#2]; ldr r1,[r0,#4]; add r0,r3,#0x10; sub r0,r1,r0; str r0,[r3,#4]; str r2,[r3,#8]; mov r0,r3; str r2,[r3,#0xc]; bx lr
names.note: callers=5. Init node: header halfword, size = end-0x10, zero [8]/[0xc], return node ptr.

names.name: wrapper_call_2_funcs_b
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; bl 0x2035138; bl 0x20351d8; add sp,sp,#4; ldm sp!,{lr}; bx lr
names.note: callers=5. Thin wrapper calling 2 sub-functions sequentially.

names.name: clz_scan_first_nonzero
names.disasm: ldr r3,[pc,#0x48]; ldr r1,[r3]; clz r2,r1; cmp r2,#0x20; movne r0,#0x40; bne...; add r3,r3,#4; ldr r1,[r3]; clz r2,r1; cmp r2,#0x20; ldr r0,[pc,#0x24]; bxeq lr
names.note: callers=5. CLZ scan over two global words; nonzero -> 0x40, both zero -> load default.

names.name: call_indirect_const_6_to_02036880
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#0xc]; mov r1,r0; ldr r0,[pc,#8]; mov r2,#6; bx ip
names.note: callers=5. Indirect call 0x02036880 with r0=global, r1=arg, r2=6.

names.name: tail_call_020354e0
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#4]; ldr r0,[pc,#4]; bx ip
names.note: callers=5. Tail call thunk -> 0x020354e0.

names.name: io_flags_bic_orr_pair
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r3,[pc,#0x58]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x58]; ldrh r0,[r3]; bic r0,r0,#3; strh r0,[r3]; ldrh r0,[r2]; bic r0,r0,#3; orr r0,r0,#1; strh r0,[r2]
names.note: callers=4. Two IO halfwords: clear bits 0-1 on A, clear bits 0-1 then set bit0 on B.

names.name: dual_state_check_eq
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r0,[pc,#0x18c]; ldr r0,[r0]; cmp r0,#0xa; bne...; ldr r0,[pc,#0x180]; ldr r0,[r0]; cmp r0,#1; bne...; mov r0,#1
names.note: callers=4. Check global A == 0xa and global B == 1 then set r0=1 (state gate).

names.name: init_sequence_calls
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r1,[pc,#0x38]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x38]; mov r0,#0x28; bl 0x2029378; ldr r0,[pc,#0x30]; mvn r1,#0; bl 0x2029250; ldr r0,[pc,#0x28]; mvn r1,#0; bl 0x2029250
names.note: callers=4. Init sequence: size 0x28 alloc + two 0x2029250 calls with -1 sentinel.

names.name: guarded_dual_state_check
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r0,[pc,#0x148]; ldr r1,[r0]; cmp r1,#1; bne...; ldr r0,[pc,#0x13c]; ldr r1,[r0]; cmp r1,#0; addeq sp,sp,#4; ldmeq sp!,{lr}; bxeq lr
names.note: callers=4. Early-return unless global A==1 and global B==0 (guard gate).

names.name: dllist_insert
names.disasm: str r2,[r1,#8]; cmp r2,#0; ldrne r3,[r2,#0xc]; strne r1,[r2,#0xc]; ldreq r3,[r0]; streq r1,[r0]; str r3,[r1,#0xc]; cmp r3,#0; strne r1,[r3,#8]; streq r1,[r0,#4]; mov r0,r1; bx lr
names.note: callers=4. Doubly-linked list insert node r1 before/after r2 (prev=8 next=0xc, head/tail ptrs r0[0]/r0[4]).

names.name: dllist_remove
names.disasm: ldr r2,[r1,#8]; ldr r1,[r1,#0xc]; cmp r2,#0; strne r1,[r2,#0xc]; streq r1,[r0]; cmp r1,#0; strne r2,[r1,#8]; streq r2,[r0,#4]; mov r0,r2; bx lr
names.note: callers=4. Doubly-linked list remove node r1 (re-link prev/next, update head/tail).

names.name: cond_byte_field_0x41_write
names.disasm: ldr r0,[r0]; cmp r0,#0; strbne r1,[r0,#0x41]; bx lr
names.note: callers=4. If global ptr nonzero write byte arg to [ptr+0x41].

names.name: signed_halfword_fixed_convert
names.disasm: cmp r1,#0; moveq r1,#0; strheq r1,[r0]; bxeq lr; cmp r1,#0; orrgt r1,r1,#0x4000; strhgt r1,[r0]; rsble r1,r1,#0; orrle r1,r1,#0x8000; strhle r1,[r0]; bx lr
names.note: callers=4. Convert signed value to fixed-point halfword: 0->0, >0 |0x4000, <0 neg |0x8000.

names.name: io_read_cond_write
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r3,[pc,#0x58]; mov lr,#0x4000000; ldrh ip,[r3]; ldr lr,[lr]; ldr r3,[pc,#0x4c]; cmp ip,#0; strh r0,[r3]; ldr r3,[pc,#0x44]; moveq r0,#0; and r3,lr,r3
names.note: callers=4. Read IO reg 0x04000000 + global halfword, conditional store & mask.

names.name: global_flags_andnot_clear_irq_safe_c
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr lr,[pc,#0x30]; mov r3,#0; ldrh ip,[lr]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x28]; mvn r1,r0; strh r3,[lr]; ldr r0,[r2]; and r1,r0,r1; str r1,[r2]; ldrh r1,[lr]
names.note: callers=4. IRQ-safe atomic AND-NOT (clear bits) into global word flag. Twin of 0x021041c0.

names.name: global_word_store_irq_safe
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#0x24]; mov r1,#0; ldrh r3,[ip]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x1c]; strh r1,[ip]; ldr r1,[r2]; str r0,[r2]; ldrh r0,[ip]; mov r0,r1; strh r3,[ip]; bx lr
names.note: callers=4. IRQ-safe direct word store to global (hword save/restore); returns previous.

names.name: struct_clear_4_fields
names.disasm: mov r2,#0; str r2,[r0,#4]; ldr r1,[r0,#4]; str r1,[r0]; str r2,[r0,#8]; str r2,[r0,#0xc]; bx lr
names.note: callers=4. Zero struct fields 0/4/8/0xc (chain-copy 4->0).
